description: Prep job for #1418 stage A (the face encode floor). Saves the three files the arm job reads back as output: references. 'frames': a video_frames decode of a stored face clip, written as the step's mp4 (dw's one encode setting: libx264 yuv420p at its default quality), so the saved file is that decode encoded once more. 'reference.png': the reference face through a pixel pass-through step (strip_exif), saved losslessly. 'reference.jpg': the same pixels saved by a dw step as image/jpeg, at PIL's defaults (quality 75, 4:2:0). No model runs; CPU only.
summary: #1418 A prep: re-encoded mp4, png and jpg reference for the face encode floor arms.
